newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA'S RMB RESOURCES SPINS OFF CONSULTANCY UNIT.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA'S RMB RESOURCES SPINS OFF CONSULTANCY UNIT.

text.p: South Africa's Rand Merchant Bank Ltd RMBH.J on Thursday said its RMB Resources mineral resources arm had spun off its Venmyn Rand consultancy business via a management buy-out.
The deal is for an undisclosed sum and will see Venmyn Rand managing director Willo Stear and deputy chairman of RMB Resources Andy Clay take charge of the firm.
"The deal leaves RMB resources free to concentrae on its core business of mergers and acquisitions as well as the investment banking side of mineral resources," RMB said in a statement.
